clips.title: The story
paras: At Brill's town hall, Executor Zygand directs Forsaken defenses across central Tirisfal Glades. He reports to the Undercity's high command and coordinates the fight against Scarlet Crusade forces pressing into Forsaken lands.

Executor Zygand directs regional defenses from Brill after the Forsaken's awakening in Deathknell. Officers such as Executor Arren and field sentries such as Deathguard Linnea report to him. He gathers scouts' reports and sends able recruits to guard Lordaeron's borders against encroachment.

The Scarlet Crusade's presence across Tirisfal Glades commands Executor Zygand's attention. He sends agents against Crusader scouts, encampments, and forward bases, keeping the zealots from gathering enough strength to threaten the approaches to the Undercity.
